# Standing rules

Every Bash call is one plain command: no heredocs, no `$(...)`, no shell arrays or loops.
Commit with the exact line from the brief.

Run the tests that cover your change and no others.

# Project Tools

- lane-info: orient in a lane: $TP_ROOT/tools/agent/lane-info.sh WORKTREE [BASE_REF] [--fetch] -> branch, base, diff, dirty files; last line exit=N log=PATH
- pre-commit-gate: prettier, eslint, typecheck, gitleaks: $TP_ROOT/tools/agent/pre-commit-gate.sh WORKTREE [BASE_REF] -> one 'name exit' line per check; last line exit=N log=PATH
- web-jest: run web jest tests: $TP_ROOT/tools/agent/web-jest.sh WORKTREE [--repeat N] TEST_PATH... -> per-file counts; last line exit=N log=PATH
